speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the rash in detail: where on your body did it start, how does it look, and does it itch or hurt? When did you first notice these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DRESS).

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP), Liver Function Tests (LFTs), and Serum Creatine Kinase.
REQUEST IMAGES: Full body dermatological photography showing the rash distribution.
